newsitem.title: GHANA: Mechanical Lloyd boosts volume on Ghana bourse.
newsitem.headline: Mechanical Lloyd boosts volume on Ghana bourse.

text.p: More than 1.2 million Mechanical Lloyd shares changed hands on the Ghana Stock Exchange on Friday, giving the best turnover since July 17, trading results showed.
The GSE All-Share Index rose 0.59 points to 381.31 and total market capitalisation climbed to 3,292.89 billion cedis from 3,292.06 billion.
Offers exceeded bids by 2,087,630 shares to 1,344,900 and 1,213,730 were traded, 1,200,100 of them in Mechanical Lloyd.
Dealers said the Mechanical Lloyd shares were bought by an institutional investor but they declined to name it. Shares in the car and agricultural equipment distributor were unchanged at 50 cedis.
Ghana Commercial Bank climbed six cedis to 729, Accra Brewery was three better at 505, Enterprise Insurance Company ended two up at 440 and Kumasi Brewery rose one cedi to 653.
Patterson Zochonis, the only decliner, fell 10 cedis to 380.
Trading in the two previous sessions this week was generally bearish, with high Central Bank interest rates weighing on the market, and very quiet, with turnover totalling 43,450.

Ashanti Goldfields Co, Ghana's biggest company, rose 100 to 30,000 cedis on Wednesday. The exchange's second biggest equity, Ghana Commercial Bank, was strong all week, rising eight on Monday and three on Wednesday.
The GSE All-Share Index ended last week at 379.88 and total market capitalisation finished at 3,281.69 billion cedis.
